mapper.select: SELECT osch.outbound_schedule_id, osch.company_id, osch.inventory_id, osch.schedule_qty, osch.schedule_date, osch.status, osch.version FROM outbound_schedules AS osch WHERE osch.outbound_schedule_id = #{outboundScheduleId} AND osch.company_id = #{companyId};

SELECT osch.outbound_schedule_id, osch.company_id, osch.inventory_id, osch.schedule_qty, osch.schedule_date, osch.status, osch.version FROM outbound_schedules AS osch WHERE osch.outbound_schedule_id = #{outboundScheduleId} AND osch.company_id = #{companyId} AND osch.version = #{version};

SELECT osch.outbound_schedule_id, proc.product_id, proc.product_code, proc.name AS product_name, wrhs.warehouse_code, wrhs.name AS warehouse_name, COALESCE(ores.total_result_qty, 0) AS total_result_qty, osch.schedule_qty, osch.schedule_date, osch.status, osch.version FROM outbound_schedules AS osch JOIN inventories AS invt ON osch.inventory_id = invt.inventory_id ANd osch.company_id = invt.company_id JOIN products AS proc ON invt.product_id = proc.product_id AND invt.company_id = proc.company_id JOIN warehouses AS wrhs ON invt.warehouse_id = wrhs.warehouse_id AND invt.company_id = wrhs.company_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT outbound_schedule_id, SUM(result_qty) AS total_result_qty FROM outbound_results WHERE company_id = #{companyId} GROUP BY outbound_schedule_id ) AS ores ON osch.outbound_schedule_id = ores.outbound_schedule_id WHERE osch.outbound_schedule_id = #{outboundScheduleId} AND osch.company_id = #{companyId};
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO outbound_schedules( company_id, inventory_id, schedule_qty, schedule_date, status ) VALUES( #{companyId}, #{inventoryId}, #{scheduleQty}, #{scheduleDate}, #{status} )
mapper.update: UPDATE outbound_schedules SET inventory_id = #{inventoryId}, schedule_qty = #{scheduleQty}, schedule_date = #{scheduleDate}, version = version + 1, updated_at = transaction_timestamp() WHERE outbound_schedule_id = #{outboundScheduleId} AND company_id = #{companyId} AND version = #{version}
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(schedule_qty), 0) FROM outbound_schedules WHERE company_id = #{companyId} AND inventory_id = #{inventoryId} AND status IN ('0', '1')
